relevance_note: Case report of an adult Japanese man with HA20: 'The results revealed a heterozygous variant of the TNFAIP3 gene, specifically c.259C>T (R87X)'; Table 2 also summarises 11 previously published HA20 cases with CNS involvement.
method_note: Read the full paper manually; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON, sliced Table 2 row segments (from the row's 'No.' cell through the cited cell) directly from the paper text and asserted every span verbatim; transcribed Table 2 values were checked cell by cell against the table. Scope: the index patient (II-3, also Table 2 case 1 'Our case', merged into II-3); three relatives (elder sister II-2, niece III-1, daughter III-3) described with oral ulceration suggestive of HA20 but not genetically tested (no variant rows); and 11 previously published HA20 cases in the Table 2 literature table, labelled 'case 2'..'case 12' after the paper's own usage ('cases 11 and 12'), with the Table 2 Reference cell in source_reference_in_review. Group-level mentions (the two families from China and France with the same variant, refs 6, 7; Kadowaki 3 of 71; Elhani 17 of 177) have no individual detail and got no rows. Table 2 notes give 'The genotype of all cases was heterozygous.', used for zygosity; 'Cases 11 and 12 are from the same family lineage' (no family label printed, relationship not stated). Non-TNFAIP3 variants NLRP3 c.214G>A and PLCG2 c.1959C>T are attributed to II-3 in Table 1 and recorded with the authors' 'limited disease relevance'. Table 2 case 5 ethnicity cell 'unknown (adopted)' recorded as not reported; its treatment cell 'Died' recorded as vital_status deceased. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients=true refers to the Table 2 literature cases, not to the index patient, who is not stated to have been reported before. n_patients_reported=1 from 'we describe a patient'; the authors do not state a total for Table 2. Diplopia was absent at the admission examination ('no evidence of diplopia') between episodes; treated as temporal, not as a contradiction, and no excluded diplopia row emitted. Laboratory values without interpretation (blood counts, CSF cell count) were not converted to features. Suspected atypical mycobacterial infection was not confirmed (cultures and antibody test negative), so recurrent infections = not reported. Contradictions: (1) age at onset for II-3: Table 2 gives '18 years', the text gives 'history of recurrent oral ulcers since 10 years of age' and symptoms/diagnosis 'at 28 years of age'; Table 2 value used for age_at_onset, 10 years kept as onset of the oral-ulcer feature. (2) The Figure 2 legend says 'R87X: TNFAIP3 gene c.159C>T variant (present case)' whereas Table 1, Table 2 and the text give c.259C>T; c.259C>T recorded. (3) 'He had no family history of autoimmune or autoinflammatory diseases' versus the later finding (after re-inquiry) that three relatives had oral ulceration suggestive of HA20. (4) Diplopia described as 'unknown onset' in the case description but 'acute-onset' in the abstract. Protein notation differs only in style: p.Arg87Ter (Table 1), p.Arg87* (Table 2), R87X (text).
